Agent Name: MenuAnalysis_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a critical error in Step 1 by constructing invalid Wayback Machine URLs. The URLs used (`https://web.archive.org/web/20210322000000*/https://www.virtuerestaurant.com/menu`) contained a wildcard (`*`) in the wrong position and format. The correct Wayback Machine URL format requires the specific date in the path (e.g., `/web/20210322000000/`) followed by the target URL, without a wildcard between the date and the target domain. This malformed URL caused the subsequent code execution to fail with a connection timeout, leading to the extraction of Wayback Machine interface text instead of the actual restaurant menu. Consequently, the data used for comparison in later steps was fabricated/hallucinated rather than retrieved from the actual archive.
